test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Eight girls, G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, G6, G7 and G8, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). G5 is third to the right of G1. G8is second to the right of G4. G4 is not the immediate neighbour of G1 or G5. G6 and G2are immediate neighbours. G2 is not the immediate neighbour of G1. G7 is not the immediate neighbour of G8.

Which of the following statements is correct?

I. G7 is the immediate left of G4.

II. G1 and G3 are neighbour of G8.

options.text: Neither I nor II is correct.
Both I and II are correct.

solution:
**Given : Eight girls, G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, G6, G7 and G8, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.**

**Explanation :**

1) G5 is third to the right of G1.

2) G4 is not the immediate neighbour of G1 or G5. 

3) G8 is second to the right of G4.

As G4 is not sitting adjacent either G1 or G5, therefore there is only one possible position for G4 with given position of G8.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffbdc5ee6f09458d5be61d95f22e9f54647a8e077dc1856bd99e65dbd6a6b1ac.png] 

4) G2 is not the immediate neighbour of G1.

5) G6 and G2are immediate neighbours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a30c23a465eaad49adbf1a37b24f4ab5eb7bf003161e394050227bee526a1cad.png] 

6) G7 is not the immediate neighbour of G8.

After position G7, only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e G3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fee99ce8f488e7a12cf61e2636ca5daaf244587976a39f1407b7712c627c05de.png] 

 

Thus, according to the final arrangement :

I. G7 is the immediate left of G4 - correct

II. G1 and G3 are neighbour of G8 - correct

Here, both the statements are correct.

Hence, **"****Both I and II are correct"** is the correct answer.
